recentItems.title: Daler Mehndi's son REACTS amid Uttarakhand 'Drunk' performance buzz; Gives update on singer's health
recentItems.description:
Daler Mehndi's son, Gurdeep Mehndi, has shared an update on the singer's health amid the controversy surrounding his alleged intoxication during a performance in Uttarakhand. While Gurdeep did not directly address the allegations, he said his father was doing well. Meanwhile, Mika Singh has come out in support of his brother, questioning the claims made against him. Watch the video for all the details.

recentItems.title: Is Bollywood Scared? Amitabh’s Jalsa, Diljit Dosanjh’s Mumbai Concert Venue Receive Bomb Threats
recentItems.description:
Amid growing concerns over security threats targeting Bollywood celebrities, fresh bomb threats have reportedly been issued against megastar Amitabh Bachchan and singer-actor Diljit Dosanjh. While Amitabh Bachchan’s Jalsa bungalow in Mumbai’s Juhu is reportedly among the targeted locations, Diljit Dosanjh’s upcoming concert venue in Mumbai has also reportedly received a threat. Watch the video.

recentItems.title: Tiger Shroff Firing Case:Two Pistols Recovered in Surat,Mumbai Crime Branch Makes Major Breakthrough
recentItems.description:
The investigation into the firing incident involving actor Tiger Shroff in Mumbai has taken a significant turn. The Mumbai Crime Branch has recovered two pistols in Surat that investigators suspect were used in the attack. The recovery marks a key development in the case, as police continue to investigate not just the alleged shooters but also those suspected of supplying weapons and helping plan the attack. Watch the video.
